scope: Promote only the existing Huihui Qwen FP4-Local and EXL3 3bit packs to TensorFold; preserve original weights and existing set IDs, hosts, endpoints and startup default. Leave EXL3 4bit and DeepSeek runtime state unchanged.

ownership.standalone: compose_yaml recipes own their files and build from their own directories.
ownership.talk: Talk owns embedded Compose/build files and materializes them under its own data_dir/runtime/<component>. Neither Qwen recipe is copied from compose_yaml during packaging or read from it during runtime.

structured_output.thinking_budget: Structured budget closure uses only the think-end token so no forced whitespace escapes the grammar

user_queue_clear.reason: User confirmed accidental Clear Queue during live Talk Medium smoke; cancelled test retried only. Long-context and prior benchmark results unaffected.

validation.switch_fix: Direct EXL3-to-FP4 switch initially refused admission because the old set retained QWIM/H3 outside the new set. Startup now quiesces unselected local managed Qwen image deployments before replacing the LLM, and credits only their measured allocations. Busy/queued image work blocks switching before the old LLM is stopped; selected image deployments remain resident. Lifecycle and memory-plan regression tests passed.
checks: Playwright: EXL3 set, reasoning controls, quantization set order passed
Upstream EXL3 vision converter tests: 5 passed
Talk-owned Qwen context materialization and no source-copy linkage test passed

deployment_spot_measurements.note: Deployment spot checks at the promoted 1M profile. The separate benchmark reports contain fair engine comparisons; do not treat these few spot rows as a new full comparative benchmark. PP and TG are separate; TG includes generated reasoning.

performance_notes: EXL3 keeps one recent prefix. Eight retained prefixes with two dynamic slots caused repeated CUDA graph capture and approximately one second of avoidable overhead per short request. With kept-prefixes=1, graph captures remain at 12 across repeated off/Medium requests, including after vision and cancellation.

Earlier controlled comparisons: native TensorFold FP4 Korean draft vocabulary improves TG by about 17% versus vLLM B12X; 128K PP is about 10% lower. EXL3 TensorFold improves TG by about 25% versus ExLlama; 16K PP is about 36% lower. See linked full reports for conditions.
External 67/80 tok/s claims use different packs, prompts or stacks. These numbers are not reproduced claims.

Do not deploy the optional B12X hybrid: the tested hybrid failed exactness with prompt/prefix caching; the FP32-router, cache-disabled prototype was slower in a short screen. The source of the slowdown was not isolated, so this does not rule out an optimized correct B12X integration.
limitations: The 1M functional checks use three synthetic retrieval keys; they are not a broad long-context quality benchmark.
The long-context checks isolate each LLM rather than retaining every custom auxiliary model concurrently. Memory admission still applies to the selected set and requested work.
Structured FP4 generation currently uses serial verification; ordinary chat retains the measured Korean MTP path.
The B12X prototype slowdown was not decomposed into routing, cache and adapter costs. An optimized correct integration remains untested.
